text:
Maria G.: Heads up — new model q6b-int8 bring-up shows an F1 drop on several intent prompt groups. Need a quick, focused sampling + labeler plan to triage whether this is tokenization, quantization, or dataset brittleness. Can we define a probe set, dedupe rules, and golden relabel ops?

Samir: I'll take sampling. Plan: 2k probe samples stratified by context length (<=128, 128-1024, >1024) and by domain (code, support, search). Also include a 200-sample holdout for deep debug. 

Devon: For dedupe thresholds — 0.95 for exact duplicates (auto-drop), 0.85 fuzzyhash for probable paraphrase. But do NOT auto-drop paraphrase; mark as 'possible_dup' and send to human review. Keep original vref ids in metadata.

Jin: Labeling: propose 3 annotators per golden sample + adjudicator for disagreements. For the 200 golden relabel, ETA is ~48h if we prioritize. We need an updated rubric with examples, especially around partial-correctness.

Rita: I'll update the rubric. Fields: correctness (0/1/partial), hallucination flag, intent match, safety flag, and a short reasoning note. Will add 6 examples per edge case.

labeler-bot: Created sampling job S-4721: samples=2000, priority=high, burst_rate=500/day. Queue URL: https://redwood.internal/curation/jobs/S-4721

Maria G.: Also add a tokenization-diff step between canonical tokenizer and new model tokenizer. If >15% token split/mismatch on the probe, escalate to tokenizer team.

Samir: Will add token-diff check. Quick command I'll run: `python tools/token-diff.py --models canonical q6b-int8 --n 1000 --out token-diff.csv`

Devon: For quant debugging, capture per-token logits on a 100-sample microset for float32 vs int8 and compare KL and top-k changes. I'll push a script into /infra/quant-smoke and link it in the job.

Jin: For eval metrics: classification intents -> macro-F1 and ROC-AUC; sequence outputs -> ROUGE-L and exact-match for short responses. Threshold: absolute drop >2% for any primary intent triggers rollback.

Rita: Tagging workflow: if sample is marked possible_dup -> labeler chooses `merge` or `keep` with reason codes (paraphrase/near-match/misalignment). We'll record pairings for future dedupe tuning.

Maria G.: Who owns golden relabel ops? I can handle escalations but want a primary owner for day-to-day. Can someone own the orchestration and reporting?

Samir: I'll own sampling + dedupe orchestration. Devon owns quant smoke and log collection. Jin owns rubric + labeling QA. Rita will own golden docs and merging rules. Maria lead for escalation.

labeler-bot: Assigned S-4721 -> @Samir. Golden relabel ticket G-9981 created and assigned to @Rita.

Samir: 👍 I'll post the sampling spec and dedupe thresholds in the runbook and attach the first 100 sample preview by EOD today.

Maria G.: Can we have initial triage results by EOD Friday? Sampling/dedupe + token-diff + a 100-sample quant-lot analysis should be enough to decide next steps.

Samir: Yes for sampling and token-diff preview. Labeling + adjudication will slip to Monday unless we expand labeler burst.

Devon: I'll aim to have logits + KL report for the 100-sample microset by Friday too. If we see concentrated KL spikes in mid-sequence tokens, that's a signal for kernel/quant mismatch.

Jin: I'll publish the rubric draft in this thread within 2 hours for quick comments.

Rita: Will spin up the golden relabel queue once the rubric is final.

Maria G.: Great — thanks all. If anyone hits blockers (quota, labeler backlog, infra), ping me immediately and DM the oncall.
